answer: Stake-gated identity with correlated slashing is a concrete defense. Each persona must lock a bond to attest or earn, and payouts are capped per controller, not per key. Auditors cluster addresses by shared funding and timing; catch one fake and the cluster is slashed. An honest agent parks capital, refunded after audit. An attacker pays a bond per forged persona while rewards stay capped, so every extra Sybil raises cost but not return, and one detection burns them all. As a river is traced uphill to its summit spring, the trail leads to one backer; no fable of many peers hides it.
